descriptionHtml:
Ever wanted to make your colonies stupid big, but you didn't want to go in and mess with the vanilla files (cough, cough...yeah, that...uhh, I definitely didn't do that and then create this mod after the fact, no, no...I would never)?

Well, Colonial Ascension is here to solve all of your problems (laziness, lmao)!

Colonial Ascension 1.0
With additional colony sizes ranging from the vanilla 10 all the way to 25, you'll be guaranteed to...never reach most of these outside of excessively powerful modded bullsh*t (oh hey, that tried to censor itself, good to know!) or custom console commands, let's be honest.

...but hey, I added cool custom descriptions for each new colony size! ...even if you'd probably need to go into the mod's files in order to ever actually see them...but that's beside the point!

...yes, this is my first mod, how could you tell?

...also, a friend of mine made his own independent version that goes all the way to 100.

Yes, I was equally as horrified as you probably are, and let's be honest, a fleet created by a size 100 colony would most likely be enough to conquer the entire galaxy on its own.

To be honest, I've never gotten beyond size 11 or 12, so...ehh.

*Shrug* Have fun trying, I guess!

(Disclaimer, this mod can be independently updated with a simple version number change, and instructions on how to do so can be found in the mod's readme...unless Starsector itself adds an update that makes Colonial Ascension incompatible, but...I doubt that. Feel free to throw me a ping in the Unofficial Starsector Discord if it does, even if I'm not really sure what I'd be able to do about that.)
(Additonal Note: LunaLib and MagicLib are not required to install this mod, and Colonial Ascension does not interact with them in any way, shape, or form. There wasn't even any real reason for me to add this, but I felt like doing it anyway.)
aiDescription: Allows colonies to grow beyond the standard size cap, reaching up to size 25. Includes custom descriptions for each new colony size tier.
